fixes_applied.1_store_isolation: Every test suite explicitly resets global stores (teams, memberships, invitations, commentsStore, auditLogsStore, activityFeed) prior to execution, preventing ambient state leakage across tests.
fixes_applied.2_dynamic_entity_creation: Tests create all required dependencies (teams, invitations, memberships, comments) on-the-fly using model factory functions rather than querying pre-seeded hardcoded IDs (e.g. userId: 1).
fixes_applied.3_cross_environment_compatibility: Eliminated environment-specific paths and local service assumptions. Node.js native test runner executes with zero external dependencies across Linux, macOS, and Windows runners.
fixes_applied.4_idempotent_teardown: Teardown blocks safely unbind event listeners and clear buffers even if test assertions throw prematurely.
